channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-11-06 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 280¢/lb — down 2.5% on the week and down 3.1% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 38 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (-0.4σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A weakening Brazilian real (+9.6% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure.
